bibl.title: Euripidean Exegesis in Papyri Other Than Commentaries
bibl.seg: Kathleen McNamee, Euripidean Exegesis in Papyri Other than Commentaries.
bibl.note: Examination of seventeen papyri that contain exegetic observations about Euripidean plays but which are not commentaries on Euripides. They include treatises on poetry and on other subjects, commentaries on other authors, and miscellaneous literary works. Appendices list (1) treatises and commentaries on authors other than Euripides which contain nonexegetic references to him or his plays and (2) papyri once thought to contain Euripidean exegesis. - Group A (Nos 1-11, all from Herculaneum). - Group B (Nos 12-14). - Group C (Nos 15-17). - Evaluation.
